RESP AXIS: resp is the CIS code unchanged (the .do only sets 8/9, or 9 alone for p18/p18a, to missing), and option_text is the ES2986 value label for that code, identical to the questionnaire's printed options; '(NO LEER)' stripped from 'Indiferente' (resp 3 of p16a/p17a). resp 0 'No procede' comes from the ES2986 value label only (a routing code, not a printed option). Mixed scales: p16/p17/p18 Sí=1/No=2; p16a/p17a 1-5 satisfaction with unread midpoint 3 'Indiferente'; p18a Sí/No; p18b 1-4 likelihood with no midpoint -- so resp 3 means 'Indiferente' on p16a/p17a but 'Poco probable' on p18b. Interviewer directions stripped: 'A TODAS LAS PERSONAS ENTREVISTADAS' header and routing arrows ('Pasar a P.18', 'Pasar a P.19', 'PASAR A P.25'). P.17b (who attended the call: machine/person/both) was administered but is not in the IRW table (the .do's keep omits p17b); not an item gap. Rebuild of the live table from DA2986 via the .do logic is exact (17388 rows, 2484 ids, 0/0 id-item-resp differences, 0 covariate mismatches).
